data.description:
## testing_mode: GREEN

## What
Create plugins/dso/hooks/check-precondition-emit.sh (chmod +x). Makes all 7 T1 tests pass. Update .test-index.

## Script Structure
Follow shape of plugins/dso/scripts/check-portability.sh for boilerplate. The key difference: scan STAGED DIFF ADDITIONS only (not whole-file content).

## Implementation

### Testability Seam
If $DSO_STAGED_DIFF_FILE env var is set, read diff from that file.
Otherwise: git diff --cached (unified diff format for all staged files).

### Target Files (check ONLY these 11)
plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md, plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/approval-gate.md, plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md, plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/auto-resume.md, plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/test-failure-dispatch-protocol.md, plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md, plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md, plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md, plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md, plugins/dso/skills/validate-work/SKILL.md, plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/epic-scrutiny-pipeline.md

### Trigger Keywords (any of these in a + addition line triggers the check)
'fall through', 'safe fallback', 'log a warning and continue', 'continue without', 'fall back', 'graceful degradation'

### Suppression Annotation
If the trigger-keyword addition line also contains '# precondition-emit-ok', skip the check for that specific line.

### Landmark Detection Algorithm (using python3 for parsing; bash for I/O)
Parse the unified diff output in one pass using python3:
1. Track current file (lines starting with '--- a/' or '+++ b/')
2. Track whether current file is a target file
3. Track hunk boundaries (lines starting with '@@')
4. Within a hunk, collect all addition lines (lines starting with '+' but NOT '++'), recording their hunk-relative position (0-indexed)
5. For each addition line containing a trigger keyword and not suppressed:
   - Check all addition lines in the same hunk that have position within [trigger_pos - 10, trigger_pos + 10]
   - If any such line contains '<!-- EMIT-PRECONDITIONS', check passes for this trigger
   - Otherwise: violation
6. On violation: print 'ERROR: <file>:<hunk-line>: trigger keyword found without nearby EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmark (within 10 lines). Add <!-- EMIT-PRECONDITIONS: ... --> within 10 lines, or add # precondition-emit-ok to suppress.' to stderr; set exit_code=1

### .test-index Update
Remove all 7 RED markers from T1.
Add: plugins/dso/hooks/check-precondition-emit.sh:tests/scripts/test-check-precondition-emit.sh

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Script executable
   Verify: test -x plugins/dso/hooks/check-precondition-emit.sh
2. All 7 tests pass
   Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-check-precondition-emit.sh
3. Trigger without landmark → exit 1
   Verify: DSO_STAGED_DIFF_FILE=tests/fixtures/precondition-emit/trigger-no-landmark.diff bash plugins/dso/hooks/check-precondition-emit.sh; test $? -eq 1
4. Trigger with nearby landmark → exit 0
   Verify: DSO_STAGED_DIFF_FILE=tests/fixtures/precondition-emit/trigger-with-nearby-landmark.diff bash plugins/dso/hooks/check-precondition-emit.sh; test $? -eq 0
5. Suppression annotation → exit 0
   Verify: DSO_STAGED_DIFF_FILE=tests/fixtures/precondition-emit/trigger-suppressed.diff bash plugins/dso/hooks/check-precondition-emit.sh; test $? -eq 0
6. RED markers removed, normal mapping added
   Verify: ! grep -q 'check-precondition-emit.sh:tests/scripts/test-check-precondition-emit.sh \[test_' .test-index && grep -q 'check-precondition-emit.sh:tests/scripts/test-check-precondition-emit.sh' .test-index
data.title: Implement check-precondition-emit.sh pre-commit hook; update .test-index
